problem_statement: Risk sweep crashes on overdue flagged livestreams. When a flagged stream is still live after its review deadline, `RiskMonitor.sweep()` raises `UnknownChannelError: livestream-audit` and aborts, so the remaining live streams are never checked. We saw this in staging last night with stream ls-2041, and the same error is raised when a `keep_live` request arrives for such a stream. Expected behaviour: the sweep completes and reports the overdue stream. `tests/test_monitor.py::test_sweep_reports_overdue_stream` reproduces it.
